text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Worst quarter of daylight half-hours by arm D's own score, 0.5 to 168 hours. D10 and D16 are placebos. Bar: 95% interval from resampling ISO weeks; bars past the axis are clipped (D9 and D10 have a small refit advantage, which makes the ratio unstable).'
text.tspan: Worst quarter of daylight half-hours by arm D's own score, 0.5 to 168 hours. D10 and D16 are placebos. Bar:
95% interval from resampling ISO weeks; bars past the axis are clipped (D9 and D10 have a small refit
advantage, which makes the ratio unstable).
